info.name: TurfSides API — owner demo turfs
info.description: Run the requests in order: 1 → 2 creates an owner account and saves the token automatically; then send the 5 turf requests. Sign-up codes are only returned while the server runs in Development mode.

request.description: Change the `phone` collection variable to your own number first (10 digits, starting with 1).

exec: if (j.devCode) { pm.collectionVariables.set('code', j.devCode); console.log('Test code saved:', j.devCode); }
if (j.accessToken) { pm.collectionVariables.set('token', j.accessToken); console.log('Signed in as', j.user && j.user.name, j.user && j.user.roles); }

item.name: 1c. Sign in (if already registered — saves token)

exec: if (j.accessToken) { pm.collectionVariables.set('token', j.accessToken); console.log('Signed in as', j.user && j.user.name, j.user && j.user.roles); }
